nuestraApp.title: Our App
nuestraApp.rulesDesc:
At COLECTIKOS we don't monitor you, we don't audit you, and we don't track you with a GPS. You decide which mode to play, and your own code of honor is your guide to which postcards you feel you can proudly unlock.
Pura Vida!
nuestraApp.modeCuriosoDesc: Unlock postcards at any time to admire the illustrations.
nuestraApp.modeNomadaDesc: Claim postcards from destinations you have crossed or seen on your route.
nuestraApp.modeConquistadorQuote: "You have lived an experience in each place"
nuestraApp.modeConquistadorDesc: You can only unlock the postcard if you walked, swam, or fully experienced the destination.
nuestraApp.instP1: Welcome to your digital logbook! Using COLECTIKOS is very intuitive. Here we explain the fundamental steps to start recording your adventures around Costa Rica and get the most out of your passport.
nuestraApp.instH2_1: 1. Prepare Your Identity (How to edit your profile)
nuestraApp.instP2_1: Before heading out to explore, you need to set up your traveler credential. Your profile is your introduction to the community and where your style is defined.
nuestraApp.instLi1_1: Access your account: Click on your Avatar or the Settings button located in the top right corner of the main menu.
nuestraApp.instLi1_2: Customize your info: Update your explorer's nickname and select your profile picture.
nuestraApp.instLi1_3: Choose your philosophy: In the 'Your Code of Honor' section, select how you will play (Curious, Nomad, or Conqueror Mode). This choice will be proudly stamped on your Exportable Passport!
nuestraApp.instLi1_4: Save changes: Press the save button to update your data.
nuestraApp.instH2_2: 2. Start the Collection (How to unlock postcards)
nuestraApp.instP2_2: The heart of COLECTIKOS is the main Home board. Here you will find all the treasures Costa Rica has to offer.
nuestraApp.instLi2_1: Explore the board: Go to the Home page to see the complete collection of available postcards (Volcanoes, Beaches, Forests, etc.).
nuestraApp.instLi2_2: Apply your Code of Honor: If you have met the requirements of your 'Game Mode' for a destination, you are ready to claim your prize.
nuestraApp.instLi2_3: Add to your album: Click the green 'Add to Album' button. The postcard will unlock, revealing the full-color illustration and adding percentage to your progress bar.
nuestraApp.instLi2_4: Uncheck postcards: If you unlocked a postcard by mistake, you can remove it from your album by pressing the red circle with an "X" that appears when you hover over the completed postcard.
nuestraApp.instLi2_5: Daily Limit & Puzzle: Every day you receive 3 tickets (energy) to unlock postcards. When you use your 3rd ticket, a special puzzle will activate to earn more XP.
nuestraApp.instLi2_6: Bonus Ticket: If you run out of energy, rate a destination for the first time today to earn 1 extra bonus ticket and keep playing.
nuestraApp.instP2_3: Your effort has large-scale rewards. As you discover individual destinations, the map will record your dominance over each province of Costa Rica.
nuestraApp.instLi3_1: Automatic unlock: You don't need to click to claim provincial postcards. The system evaluates your progress and magically unlocks them for you.
nuestraApp.instLi3_2: Metallic evolution: Each province's postcard will change color based on the percentage of milestones you have completed there. As you add discovered places, the postcard will upgrade, adopting brilliant metallic tones (advancing to Bronze, Silver, and finally the coveted Gold).
nuestraApp.instLi3_3: The Province's Verdict: Each province will show a 'Community Rating'. As a user, you cannot rate a province directly; this score is calculated automatically by averaging the community ratings of all the places belonging to that province.
nuestraApp.instH2_4: 4. Immortalize the Moment (How to write your memories)
nuestraApp.instP2_4: A true traveler not only collects places but also stories. Each unlocked postcard is a blank space for your memories.
nuestraApp.instLi4_1: Open your postcard: Click on any postcard you have already unlocked to see it in detail.
nuestraApp.instLi4_2: Add your memory: Look for the logbook section inside the postcard. There you can write a short text about your experience: who you went with, the weather, or that funny anecdote you don't want to forget.
nuestraApp.instLi4_3: Keep your story: Save your note. Now, every time you check your album, you won't just see the destination's beautiful art, but you will relive exactly what you felt being there.
nuestraApp.instP2_5: Your opinion is key to the Growth Together of our community. Help us discover which are the true gems of Costa Rica!
nuestraApp.instLi5_1: Rate with Paw Prints: On the postcard of each unlocked place, you can rate your experience by selecting 1 to 4 Otico paw prints (1 = 'Hard Pass', 2 = 'mmm...ok', 3 = 'Awesome Vibe', 4 = 'Absolute Must!').
nuestraApp.instLi5_2: Social Contrast: Right below your personal rating, you will see the average 'Community Rating' for that specific destination. Discover immediately if you were the only one to find that hidden gem or if everyone shares your exact wonder.
nuestraApp.instH2_6: 6. Show Off Your Achievements (How to export your digital passport)
nuestraApp.instP2_6: Your effort deserves recognition. COLECTIKOS generates an official and personalized passport with your progress, ready to share with the world.
nuestraApp.instLi6_1: Visit your profile: Head to your personal space by clicking on your Avatar.
nuestraApp.instLi6_2: Generate your passport: Look for the 'Digital Passport' button in your profile. Pressing it will create your official high-quality passport ready to share or save to your photos.
nuestraApp.instLi6_3: Discover your stamp: This image will include your name, current level, percentage of the map conquered, and your official Game Mode.
nuestraApp.instLi6_4: Share with the world: Download the image and upload it to your social media to challenge your friends or show off your explorer rank.
nuestraApp.instH2_7: 7. Your Next Adventure (My 4 Destinations to Visit)
nuestraApp.instP2_7: Plan ahead and keep your motivation high. Select the postcards that will be your next goals.
nuestraApp.instLi7_1: Little Flag: On any postcard you haven't unlocked yet, tap the flag icon in the top corner to add it to your upcoming destinations. You can choose up to a maximum of 4 postcards.
nuestraApp.instLi7_2: New section: Your selections now have their own dedicated page. To view them, navigate in the menu to Destinations > My Upcoming Destinations.
nuestraApp.instLi7_3: Plan your trip: On this new screen you will not only see your goals, but you will also find Area Recommendations and a suggested itinerary to make the most of your trip. When you visit the destination and mark it as completed, it will be automatically removed from your wishlist.
nuestraApp.instH2_8: The Journey Continues (Evolution of your Level and Explorer Resilience)
nuestraApp.instP2_8: COLECTIKOS is a living album that never stops. We will constantly be adding new places, routes, and categories so you always have a reason to explore Costa Rica.
nuestraApp.instLi8_1: The album always grows: Due to this constant growth, your conquest percentage and explorer level may change over time. If we add new destinations and you haven't visited them yet, your overall level might adjust temporarily.
nuestraApp.instLi8_2: An invitation to resilience: Don't see this as a setback, but as a new mission! Exploration never ends, and every update is an invitation to head back out, discover hidden corners, and reclaim or surpass your rank. A true explorer embraces the challenge!

nuestraApp.secretsTitle: Collector's Secrets: Get the Most out of COLECTIKOS
nuestraApp.secretsIntro: Having your passport at 100% isn't just about traveling a lot, but traveling strategically. Here are the tricks from our most active users to get the most out of the platform.
nuestraApp.secP1: Don't just open the app when you're already at the destination. Expert collectors log into COLECTIKOS every Thursday afternoon to plan their weekend. Check your dashboard, filter by the province you are going to visit, and find out if there's a hidden waterfall or national park along your route. Using the app as your "Bucket List" will transform a routine trip into an expedition of conquest.
nuestraApp.secP2: Want to impress your friends with a Gold provincial postcard? Check your progress map frequently. Sometimes you'll discover you're missing just one destination (a historic church or a small lagoon) for your entire province to upgrade from Silver to Gold. Identifying these quick wins will help you decide your next Sunday stop.
nuestraApp.secSub3: 3. The Hot Logbook (Write From the Location)
nuestraApp.secP3: The biggest mistake is waiting until you get home to record your memories. The best stories are written while you're drinking coffee in front of the volcano or resting on the sand. Open your app right then, claim your postcard, and write your memory while the emotions, weather, and details are fresh. Your future "You" will thank you for that authenticity.
nuestraApp.secP4: COLECTIKOS is more than an individual album. Form your own WhatsApp group with other explorers or join COLECTIKOS online communities. Sharing photos of your real postcards and checking road conditions before a trip will turn you into a true Local Legend in the community.
nuestraApp.historyTitle: Our Story: The Birth of COLECTIKOS
nuestraApp.historyP1: It all started with a simple conviction: Costa Rica is much more than the destinations that appear on magazine covers. Behind every usual route, there are secret waterfalls, mountain trails, silent lagoons, as well as vibrant urban corners full of art and culture that deserve to be celebrated. However, amidst the routine and daily stress, it is easy to lose the capacity for wonder at the country that surrounds us.
nuestraApp.historyP2: COLECTIKOS was born to break that inertia. We realized that the best way to motivate people to leave their homes was to transform exploration into an interactive challenge. By merging the richness of our natural and urban environment with the nostalgia of a collectible album, we created an ecosystem where discovering the hidden gems of Costa Rica ceases to be a simple trip and becomes a journey of personal growth.
nuestraApp.historyP3: Beyond technology, our central purpose is well-being: we seek to generate joy in everyday life. We understand that going out to explore, completing a challenge, and sharing it with an active community is a powerful engine for mental health. Through the art of our digital stickers and the spirit of progress, COLECTIKOS is an open invitation to collect adventures and treasure unforgettable memories, connecting those looking to rediscover the country with the places waiting to be found.
nuestraApp.historyMissionDesc: To inspire locals and travelers to discover the hidden gems of Costa Rica, transforming exploration into an interactive experience that allows collecting adventures, treasuring memories, and generating joy in everyday life through a vibrant community.
nuestraApp.historyVisionDesc: To become the new fever of the community: the digital destination where every person, from the weekend explorer to the local legend, finds their space to play, celebrate the natural and cultural richness of Costa Rica, support authentic tourism, and document their own collection of discoveries.
nuestraApp.historyGrowthDesc: We believe in the power of our people. It is the adventurers and local legends themselves who, by completing their album, overcoming challenges, and sharing direct recommendations, bring to light the true hidden gems of Costa Rica, making the platform and tourism grow with the experience of each traveler.
nuestraApp.historyWonderDesc: We believe the magic lies in discovering the unknown, rewarding the curiosity of those who dare to step off the traditional routes, whether exploring the heart of the forest or discovering the historical and cultural life of the city.
nuestraApp.historyImpactDesc: We understand recreation, contact with nature, and immersion in our urban culture as fundamental tools to disconnect from stress and inject happiness into the daily routine.
nuestraApp.historyCommunityDesc: We foster a safe space where a user's progress and the collection of their postcards inspire others to start their own journey.
nuestraApp.historyIdentityDesc: We celebrate Costa Rican biodiversity and folklore by protecting and elevating the graphic art in each unlocked destination.

terminos.title: Terms of Use & Privacy Policy
terminos.sec1Desc: Colectikos, operated by Gema Digital S.R.L., is exclusively a digital logbook and a personal registration platform. We do not act as a tour operator, travel agency, or certified guides. The application is purely for entertainment purposes and the illustrations of the destinations do not guarantee their actual conditions, accessibility, or safety.
terminos.sec2Desc: The user expressly acknowledges and accepts that any physical displacement, excursion, or travel to the destinations illustrated in the application is carried out at their own exclusive risk. Gema Digital S.R.L. assumes no civil, criminal, or administrative liability for accidents, injuries, health issues, property damage, or mishaps suffered before, during, or after visiting any destination.
terminos.sec3Desc: The mechanics of collecting postcards, user levels, and travel philosophies (including "Conqueror Mode") are playful self-evaluation systems based on a Code of Honor. Colectikos does not promote, organize, or endorse physical competitions, time trials, or reckless excursions. No virtual achievement or digital medal justifies endangering your own physical integrity or that of third parties.
terminos.sec4Desc: The user agrees to abide by Costa Rican legislation at all times during their travels. This includes strict compliance with the Traffic Law, the schedules and regulations of National Parks dictated by SINAC, the prohibition of entering restricted areas or private properties without authorization, and the care of the environment.
terminos.sec5Title: 5. Consent and Rights of Use over User-Generated Content
terminos.sec5Desc: By sharing, sending, tagging or facilitating photographs, videos or other visual materials to Colectikos through social networks, direct messages or any other channel, the user declares to be the author and legitimate owner of the patrimonial and moral rights of said content. By this action, the user grants Gema Digital S.R.L. a non-exclusive, free, royalty-free, perpetual and territorially unlimited license to store, edit, adapt, reproduce and publish said images. This consent expressly covers the exhibition of the material in the 'Community Album' within our website and platforms, its dissemination in our social networks (including, but not limited to, posts, stories, reels and similar formats), as well as its integration in advertising guidelines, marketing campaigns and any promotional material. Gema Digital S.R.L. will make a reasonable effort to attribute credit to the original author when using their content, provided that the design and format allow it.
terminos.sec6Desc: The designs, illustrations, logos, and visual structure of the digital postcards are the exclusive intellectual property of Gema Digital S.R.L. Their alteration, manipulation, editing, copying, or falsification is strictly prohibited. Furthermore, it is explicitly forbidden for third parties (including, but not limited to, private businesses, institutions, organizations, or any other entity) to create, publish, or distribute on social networks or other media any images or campaigns that imitate the graphic style of Colectikos to promote establishments, destinations, or services without a formal, written commercial agreement with our platform.
terminos.sec7Desc: At Colectikos, user privacy is fundamental. We collect only the information necessary to provide, maintain, and improve our services: (a) Account Information: When you sign up using email or third-party identity providers such as Google or Apple, we collect your name, email address, and public profile picture. (b) Collector Profile Information: Explorer's nickname, optional demographic details (gender, age bracket, residence province), and travel preferences. (c) Album & Activity Data: Unlocked postcards, upcoming bucket list destinations, personal notes, and visit dates.
terminos.sec8Title: 8. Purpose of Data Processing & Google Sign-In
terminos.sec8Desc: We use the collected information exclusively to: securely authenticate your identity, maintain active sessions, synchronize and preserve your album collection progress, personalize your experience within the platform, and provide community features. When signing in with Google, we only request access to your standard Google public profile (name, email address, profile photo) to create and link your Colectikos account.
terminos.sec9Title: 9. Compliance with Google API Services User Data Policy
terminos.sec9Desc: Colectikos' use and transfer of information received from Google APIs to any other app will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements. We do not sell, rent, or trade Google user data to data brokers or third-party advertisers, nor do we use this data for training generalized artificial intelligence or machine learning models.
terminos.sec10Desc: Colectikos does not sell your personal data. We share information only with trusted third-party service providers strictly necessary for platform operations: Clerk (secure identity management and authentication), Vercel (cloud web hosting infrastructure), and managed PostgreSQL database providers for encrypted storage of your collection. All service providers adhere to industry-standard data security and privacy practices.
terminos.sec11Title: 11. Data Retention, User Rights & Account Deletion
terminos.sec11Desc: You retain full rights to access, rectify, or request the complete and permanent deletion of your account and all associated personal data at any time. To exercise your privacy rights or request account deletion, simply contact us by email at soporte@colectikos.com with the subject line 'Data Deletion Request'. Your request will be fulfilled within 48 hours.
terminos.sec12Desc: The data controller responsible for your information is Gema Digital S.R.L., located in Costa Rica. If you have any questions, inquiries, or concerns regarding these Terms of Use or our Privacy Policy, please contact us directly at soporte@colectikos.com.

communityFaq.q1_1: How can I invite my friends to join the page?
communityFaq.a1_1: Your help in growing the community is very valuable. Please help us spread the word in conversations with your friends or through your social networks. Invite them to follow us on Facebook and Instagram, and of course to start their collection at Colectikos.com.
communityFaq.q1_2: Can I connect with my friends and see their progress like a social network?
communityFaq.a1_2: Colectikos focuses first on your personal logbook (Founder's Edition) and global community ratings. Community interaction is planned to take place through our social networks. Who knows! Maybe in the future we will have messaging or chat within Colectikos.
communityFaq.q2_1: How do I submit my photos to participate in the most viewed photos?
communityFaq.a2_1: You can share your photographs on our social media walls or send them via private messages. When you do so, we count on your consent to use the photographs to further beautify Colectikos.com and participate in the dynamics of our Community.
communityFaq.q2_2: Can I save my photos on the platform?
communityFaq.a2_2: We hope to receive many photographs contributed by our Community from the different locations of our beautiful piece of land. The best photos will be shared in our Community Album or on the walls of our different dynamics.
communityFaq.q3_1: Why doesn't Colectikos have all the places in Costa Rica?
communityFaq.a3_1: Colectikos is a curated album of 100 essential milestones that define the essence of the country. Furthermore, it is a living ecosystem: the platform constantly grows by adding new destinations over time. We count on you to tell us about those places you think should be in the album, and send us photos, to give visibility to the whole Community of those thousands of hidden gems that Costa Rica has.
communityFaq.q3_2: If I live in another country, can I use Colectikos?
communityFaq.a3_2: Absolutely! Colectikos is accessible from anywhere in the world via the web. Many Costa Ricans abroad and foreigners in love with the country use it to plan their next vacations or keep their love for Costa Rica alive.
communityFaq.q3_3: Are the explorer levels different for a visitor than for a resident?
communityFaq.a3_3: No. Explorer levels are the same for all Colectikos users. What can be different is the way you play. If you live abroad, you can play by unlocking postcards of places you have deeply researched, or of which you have seen videos online, for example. The love and passion for getting to know every corner of Costa Rica can also be manifested virtually. We provide you with the album and postcards; you decide how you will play to unlock them.

gamification.rule8Title: 8. Become a Legend (How to earn XP, Streaks, and Levels)
gamification.rule8Intro: Your Digital Passport not only keeps memories, it also recognizes your adventurous spirit. As you explore Costa Rica and use the app, you will accumulate traveler stats. Here is how the game works:
gamification.rule8StreaksIntro: Loyalty has its reward! The fire icon next to your name indicates your active streak.
gamification.rule8StreaksLi1: Earn XP for logging in: Just by opening the app once a day, you will earn experience points (XP) and add a day to your streak.
gamification.rule8StreaksLi2: Beware of forgetting: If you spend a whole day without entering COLECTIKOS, the fire streak will go out and reset to 1. Keep the flame alive!
gamification.rule8XpIntro: XP measures how active you are in the community. COLECTIKOS is designed for you to enjoy the scenery and not to race, so your daily 'collection energy' has a strategic limit:
gamification.rule8XpLi1: Unlock Postcards (Daily limit): You only earn XP for the first three postcards you unlock each day (50 XP for the first two and 25 XP for the third). From the fourth postcard of the day onwards, you won't earn XP.
gamification.rule8XpLi2: Unique Postcards: You only receive XP the first time you unlock a postcard. If you decide to lock it and unlock it again later, you won't earn additional XP.
gamification.rule8XpLi3: Rate Destinations: Your first two reviews of the day grant you 20 XP each, and the third 10 XP.
gamification.rule8LevelIntro: In COLECTIKOS we reward both your constant effort and your exploration feats, so there are two types of progress:
gamification.rule8LevelLi1: User Levels (XP): Represented by the number in your profile (Level 1, Level 2, etc.). You will automatically level up for every 100 XP you accumulate interacting with the app. There is no limit!
gamification.rule8LevelLi2: Collector Levels: These are honorary ranks (like 'Newcomer', 'Hotstepper', etc. until reaching Tico100/Tica100) that you acquire exclusively by unlocking more and more postcards in your album, regardless of the XP you have.
gamification.rule8LevelLi3: Your Legacy: The higher both your levels are, the more respect you will command in the COLECTIKOS community of explorers.
gamification.toastPostcardLimit: Take it easy and enjoy the view! 🌴 You've reached today's XP limit. From your 4th postcard onwards you won't earn XP, but you can keep collecting and adding discoveries to your album. Tomorrow we reload XP!
gamification.toastRatingLimit: What a great contribution to the community! 🗣️ You've earned all possible XP for your first 3 ratings today. You can keep leaving stars to recommend places, but XP will return tomorrow.
